summary: This file is a pure configuration dictionary (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines model settings for a Cascade R-CNN object detection model using a ResNet-50 backbone and FPN neck, with 3-stage RoI heads, RPN configuration, and train/test hyperparameters for MMDetection.
note: No callable code exists in this file — it is a configuration-only file consisting of nested dict literals assigned to the variable 'model'. No argparse CLI or importable functions are present.
